verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so official SDKs are a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence pack never mentions an SDK, client library or developer API. The Excel connector and source-system integrations are adjacent features, not SDKs, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
